iOS 27 will launch this fall for all users, here’s what’s new for the Apple Wallet app in the next major iPhone update.

Create a Pass

Apple Wallet is continually improving, with several recent updates in iOS 26. But iOS 27 will bring more new features to Wallet users.

Create a Pass is a new feature you’ll find when you hit the + button inside iOS 27’s Wallet app.

It enables you to create a pass in one of two ways:

  • Scan a physical pass to import it using your iPhone’s camera and visual intelligence
  • Create a pass manually from scratch

The former requires the next-gen Apple Intelligence capabilities. Creating a pass manually, meanwhile, provides you with three options: Standard, Membership, and Event.

The goal is that Apple wants to make the Wallet app your go-to hub for all kinds of passes, whether they’re digital or physical.

Split Bill with Apple Cash

Split Bill with Apple Cash is another iOS 27 addition to Wallet.

When using the new Siri mode in the Camera app to scan a receipt, you’ll see the option to Split Bill with Apple Cash.

From here, the Wallet app opens and you’ll be presented with options to ‘Request’ payment from others or ‘Pay Your Share.’ It’s quick, easy, and offers another reason to use Apple Cash.

Recurring transactions for Apple Card

If you use Apple Card, there’s a convenient new hub in iOS 27 for all your recurring transactions.

Behind the three-dot icon in the top-right corner of the Apple Card screen, there’s a new ‘Recurring’ option.

This shows you all upcoming recurring transactions. You can see them on a calendar month view, or listed out.

Essentially, this new section provides an easy way to track current subscriptions and anticipate upcoming charges.

Hotel Key upgrades

Beyond some small UI updates and a refreshed app icon, the last noteworthy iOS 27 feature for Apple Wallet involves hotel keys.
